title: Anime rooftop wind
prompt_en: Anime style, 16:9. A high school girl stands on a rooftop at sunset, wind blowing her hair and scarf, cherry petals drifting past. Hand-drawn look, soft cel shading, warm pastel sky, gentle camera pan.
prompt_zh: 日系动画风格，16:9。高中女生站在日落时的天台上，风吹动她的头发和围巾，樱花瓣飘过。手绘质感，柔和赛璐璐着色，暖色粉彩天空，镜头轻柔平移。
why_it_works: Wind-driven secondary motion (hair, scarf, petals) is where anime style looks most alive.
